ELECTRICITY — TERMLY EXAM #14
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ELECTRICITY
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Computer Aided Drafting and Design, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Aided Drafting and Design.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Aided Drafting and Design.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Computer Aided Drafting and Design.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Aided Drafting and Design.
